snippet.title: VEREDA - Escape Room Puzzle Adventure Game - Steam - Windows, Mac, Linux, iOS, Android
snippet.description:
STEAM (PC / MacOS / Linux): https://store.steampowered.com/app/1899430/VEREDA__Mystery_Escape_Room_Adventure/
Apple AppStore (iOS / iPadOS) : https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vereda-escape-room-adventure/id1612242178
GooglePlay (Android) : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=co.uk.m9games.puzzle.adventure.vereda

Vereda is a 3d escape room puzzle adventure. Play as a secret agent assigned a mission to recover a secret dossier set in an unusual town. Explore areas and take in your surroundings. Use all of your puzzle solving skills to make your way through the town and recover the missing dossier.

VEREDA - Mystery Escape Room Adventure
As a secret undercover agent used to adventure and mystery you are tasked with your latest mission to infiltrate a town guarding a top secret dossier. What the dossier contains is not known, your sole focus is just to find and recover it. What you are not prepared for is the lengths the dossier has been protected. It’s down to you to use all your experience to solve the puzzles and contraptions that block your way.


A letter left in your room briefly describes your mission:

“…the dossier in question is located in a building further into town. We cannot give you much more information than this, as details are unclear due to the unique situation you find yourself in. To prepare you for what is to come, we have primed your room with a small training exercise…”

With this your mission begins…

If you enjoy escape rooms, solving puzzles, riddles and collecting items to open doors and chests then Vereda is a game you need in your collection. 3D environments to explore both inside and outside, with a strong escape room emphasis to challenge puzzle solving players of all skill levels.

Take a look at the current Steam page for availability and join in the escape room puzzle fun!

STEAM Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1899430/VEREDA__Mystery_Escape_Room_Adventure/
